'''Beef noodle soup''' is a [[noodle soup]] made of [[stewed]] or [[Braising|braised]] [[beef]], beef [[broth]], [[vegetable]]s and [[noodle]]s.

One of the oldest beef noodle soups is the [[Lanzhou lamian|Lanzhou niuroumian]] (蘭州牛肉麵), or Lanzhou beef noodle soup, which was created by the [[Hui people]] of northwest China during the [[Tang dynasty]].<ref>Lonely Planet Food, The World's Best Spicy Food, Lonely Planet, 2017</ref><ref>Nate Tate, Feeding the Dragon: A Culinary Travelogue Through China with Recipes, Andrews McMeel Publishing, 2011</ref> There are numerous beef noodle soups available in China with a higher variety in the [[Western China|west]] than the east.{{Citation needed|date=November 2021}}

Another common variety is the [[Red cooking|red-braised]] [[Taiwanese beef noodle soup|beef noodle soup]] (紅燒牛肉麵) from [[Taiwan]], which was first created by [[Sichuanese people|Sichuanese]] [[Kuomintang]] veterans;<ref>{{cite web|script-title=zh:四川」牛肉麵其實源自台灣？一窺牛肉麵的背後故事|url=https://food.ltn.com.tw/article/2347|website=Liberty Times Net|date=9 October 2017|publisher=Liberty Times|access-date=26 September 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=焦|first1=桐|script-title=zh:一碗紅燒牛肉麵，喚醒許多人共同的歷史記憶|url=https://gvlf.gvm.com.tw/article_content_12306.html|script-website=zh:遠見華人 精英論壇|access-date=26 September 2018}}</ref> it is commonly known as Taiwanese beef noodle soup in English.

Other beef noodle soup varieties include [[pho]] from [[Vietnam]].
